from pathlib import Path
s=Path('tools/reference/projectile-frame-observe.ts').read_text().replace('projectile-frame-observe.ts','projectile-target-observe.ts').replace('projectile-frame-runtime','projectile-target-runtime').replace('9255','9295').replace('3255','3295').replace('BT3_PROJECTILE_DONE 40','BT3_TARGET_DONE')
Path('tools/reference/projectile-target-observe.ts').write_text(s)
import json,os
roots=[2469262,2482751]
rows={}
for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdigit():continue
 try:
  st=(p/'stat').read_text();f=st[st.rfind(')')+2:].split();rows[int(p.name)]={'pid':int(p.name),'ppid':int(f[1]),'start':f[19],'cmd':(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\\0',b' ').decode(errors='replace').strip()}
 except (OSError,IndexError):pass
owned=set(roots)
while True:
 new={pid for pid,v in rows.items() if v['ppid'] in owned};n=owned|new
 if n==owned:break
 owned=n
out={'boot_id':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),'roots':roots,'processes':[rows[x] for x in sorted(owned) if x in rows]}
Path('reference-captures/projectile-target-runtime/owned-processes.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\\n')
print('Recorded',len(out['processes']),'owned process identities.')
PY

items.text:
The original canonical call confirms the discrepancy: the empty-target seeker returns from Spawn with movement enabled, runs once from `(4,5)` to `(7,5)`, queues a second removal, then stops. Direct Setup leaves it at `(4,5)`.

The probe also confirms physical target containment and fractional hit-point conversion. I’ll correct PR #142’s birth-phase model and keep queued removal separate from movement enablement.
